notes.title: New playable mechanics! Accompany the customer to his home and satisfy him!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is a huge content update as it adds more depth to the gameplay.

-A new mechanic has been added to the game: You will now accompany each client to his home and you will have to satisfy his desires as much as possible before his time is up to earn extra money.

-New scenes with the clients have been added (blowjobs of the blonde and brunette prostitutes).

- and more improvements are coming soon!

-Bugs and errors in the translations have been corrected.

Thanks a lot to all the dear Prostitute Simulator 2 community for your comments and patience. We hope you will keep sending us your feedback to improve it!

notes.title: Major update: New 3D models and improved gameplay
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! We are proud to announce the big change we have added to the game thanks to all your support. The sales are being incredible all around the world and to reward you we have added a huge new patch today with many improvements:

-New models for the prostitutes protagonists of the realistic mode. They now have much more details, spicier outfits and facial expressions.

-Now you can sprint to run away at full speed from the police because you are dressed so flashy that they will go to stop as soon as they see you.

-You can now pose with your prostitute to attract even more attention from customers.

-More cops have been added to the cities and their speed has been modified to make the game more challenging and fun.

-More exciting new features coming soon!

Thank you all for your great support to Prostitute Simulator 2!
